scope: Shingles are concatenations of five framed tokens, with no token-count prefix in a shingle, using only independently authored L3 streams. Sets deduplicate repeated shingles. Exact integer Jaccard threshold comparison and floor score. These are local pair arithmetic expectations, not emitted CloneCandidateGroupV2 or Fact2 records; whole-universe connected components, candidate body ids/paths/owned context and full normalized atoms remain pending. No cross-language pair is asserted or compared. Near is candidate-only and claims no semantic equivalence or deletion authority.
